tickets.title: Prepare Cloudberry Kite Analytics launch cash-flow map
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month cash-flow map for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC covering household draws, expected retainer receipts, software costs, estimated tax reserves, and minimum cash thresholds. Reflect the consulting income pattern rather than a salary.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that cash-flow map for March 18, 2026.

tickets.title: Develop owner-draw and tax set-aside method
tickets.text: Develop a repeatable owner-draw and tax set-aside method for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC that accounts for the timing changes from payroll employee to self-employed consultant. Address household paychecks and draws during low-receipt months.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to develop that method for March 20, 2026.

tickets.title: Correct Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC banking application
tickets.text: Correct the Teacup Comet Bank application for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC, which currently shows the shortened business name instead of the full LLC name used in the state filing and IRS record. Resolve the online portal’s rejection of the EIN confirmation upload.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to correct the application issue for March 6, 2026.

tickets.title: Complete Silver Marmot Market Lab invoice and payment-routing setup
tickets.text: Complete the invoice and ACH payment-routing setup for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC’s Silver Marmot Market Lab retainer before the first billing cycle. Set up routing for business receipts separate from household cash.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the invoice and payment-routing setup for March 5, 2026.

tickets.title: Obtain Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC entity formation document packet
tickets.text: Obtain the Oregon articles, EIN letter, operating agreement, and initial resolution for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC for the planning file. These documents are required by the bank and bookkeeping provider.
tickets.evidence: The unresolved follow-up need is to obtain that document packet for March 8, 2026.

tickets.text: Reconcile the $15,000 monthly contracted revenue in Elena’s planning worksheet with the signed Silver Marmot Market Lab statement of work showing $12,000 per month and no other signed client contract.
tickets.evidence: The unresolved follow-up need is to reconcile that forecast for March 15, 2026.

tickets.title: Create business bookkeeping and receipt workflow
tickets.text: Create a bookkeeping and receipt workflow for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC addressing the current mix of business charges across the household credit card, personal checking, and new business debit card. Cover software, laptop, and professional dues purchases.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to create a bookkeeping and receipt workflow for March 22, 2026.

tickets.title: Address business and household cash reserve segmentation
tickets.text: Address the current single high-yield savings account holding both the household reserve and proposed business tax reserve. Improve the distinction between emergency funds and amounts held for taxes and near-term business expenses.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address cash reserve segmentation for March 28, 2026.

tickets.title: Request insurance policy review materials
tickets.text:
Outreach recipient: Elena Pebblefizz / insurance professional / other
Policy type: professional liability and cyber liability

Message outline:
Hello [recipient name],

We are reviewing Elena Pebblefizz’s professional liability and cyber coverage for client data work as part of her broader financial planning work. Please provide the following items if available:
- Current policy declaration page or policy summary
- Premium amount and payment frequency
- Coverage amount, riders, exclusions, and ownership details
- Beneficiary information, if applicable
- Cash value, loan balance, or surrender value, if applicable
- In-force illustration or current projection, if applicable
- Any pending changes, lapses, or underwriting updates

Please let us know if a specific authorization form is needed before releasing information.

Thank you,
[advisor or team name]
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that estimate for March 25, 2026.

tickets.title: Collect final payroll and benefits documents
tickets.text: Collect Elena Pebblefizz’s final paystub, unused vacation payout details, and COBRA notice from Paper Otter Health Systems for the planning file. These documents are needed to estimate current-year wages and benefit costs.
tickets.evidence: The unresolved follow-up need is to collect those documents for March 12, 2026.

tickets.title: Create estimated tax payment calendar
tickets.text: Create an estimated tax payment calendar for Cloudberry Kite Analytics LLC with payment reminders tied to the new consulting income pattern. Coordinate with Victor Thimblefern on calculating the first business estimate after final payroll figures and first invoices are available.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to create that calendar for March 31, 2026.
